versions.subject: add zerologon rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4742
    SourceUserName: 'ANONYMOUS LOGON'
    TargetUserName: '%DC-MACHINE-NAME$%' # DC machine account name that ends with '$'
filter:
    ChangedAttributes|contains:
        - 'Password Last Set:	-'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID=4742 SourceUserName="ANONYMOUS LOGON" TargetUserName="%DC-MACHINE-NAME$%" NOT ChangedAttributes="*Password Last Set: -*"
